overview_description.description:
Shorages
 is a technology-driven logistics and fulfillment company founded in Dubai that helps e-commerce brands streamline warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, and regional distribution across the GCC. Established in 2019, the company operates fulfillment centers in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, enabling businesses to scale without investing in their own warehouse infrastructure. The platform integrates with major e-commerce marketplaces and storefronts including Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, Noon, Salla, and Zid, allowing merchants to automate storage, pick-and-pack operations, shipping, and last-mile delivery through a centralized system. Shorages focuses on providing flexible, on-demand fulfillment services with transparent pricing, fast dispatch times, and scalable logistics support for direct-to-consumer and B2B businesses.

about_short_description.short_description: Shorages is a logistics & e-commerce fulfillment company, provides warehousing, order fulfillment & distribution services for online brands.

product.name: Warehousing
product.description: Provides on-demand storage for products in secure warehouses located across Dubai and Riyadh.

product.name: Order Fulfillment and Delivery
product.description: Handles picking, packing, and delivering ecommerce orders from warehouses to customers and businesses.

product.name: Marketplace Order Fulfillment
product.description: Supports storage, preparation, and delivery of orders for ecommerce marketplaces such as Amazon and Noon in the GCC.

product.name: B2B and Retail Fulfillment
product.description: Manages inventory, labeling, packing, invoicing, and delivery for business-to-business and retail replenishment orders.

product.name: Distribution and Product Registration
product.description: Acts as importer on record to import, register, and distribute products across GCC countries, including regulated items.
